name: UFO Pyramids
review:
Ancient Egypt meets alien conspiracy theories on a triangle-shaped pay-anywhere grid – it looks like nothing else around.

Fast gameplay, with free spins and a bonus buy at 100x. Very high volatility, a 5,000x max and an excellent 97.17% RTP, with free spins about once every 163 spins. Worth a spin for the layout alone.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
